q.zh: 半導體是護國神山，還是讓台灣得了「荷蘭病」？
q.en: Is the chip industry a “sacred mountain” protecting the country, or has it given Taiwan “Dutch disease”?

ctx.zh: 「荷蘭病」指單一出口部門太強，帶動匯率與薪資上升，擠壓其他產業。2025 年 11 月《經濟學人》的報導把這個說法用在台灣身上，央行公開回應；國內的討論更早就開始了。
ctx.en: “Dutch disease” describes a single export sector so strong that it pushes up the exchange rate and wages and squeezes other industries. In November 2025 The Economist applied the term to Taiwan and the central bank responded publicly; the domestic debate had started earlier.

voices.quote: 台灣是否已罹患荷蘭病？或許尚未到病入膏肓的地步，但症狀已浮現。

tr.zh: 台灣是否已罹患荷蘭病？或許尚未到病入膏肓的地步，但症狀已浮現。
tr.en: Has Taiwan already caught Dutch disease? Perhaps it is not yet beyond cure, but the symptoms have appeared.

role.en: author of “The Economic Chessboard of the New Cold War”

venue.zh: 書摘，聯合新聞網轉載
venue.en: book excerpt carried by udn.com

voices.quote: 台灣不能只有一個產品、一個產業，因為孤注一擲於單一產業，就好像一座森林植物太過單一，容易有一榮俱榮、一枯俱枯的現象

tr.zh: 台灣不能只有一個產品、一個產業，因為孤注一擲於單一產業，就好像一座森林植物太過單一，容易有一榮俱榮、一枯俱枯的現象
tr.en: Taiwan cannot have just one product and one industry; staking everything on a single industry is like a forest with too few species, where everything flourishes together and withers together.

venue.zh: 風傳媒十一週年論壇（中央社報導）
venue.en: Storm Media 11th-anniversary forum (reported by CNA)

voices.quote: 當前台灣面臨電子資通訊製造業表現優於傳統製造業之分化狀況，惟傳統製造業仍持續成長，並努力朝高值化方向，以及跨入AI等供應鏈，進行產業升級轉型，與1960年代之荷蘭產業發展存在顯著差異

tr.zh: 當前台灣面臨電子資通訊製造業表現優於傳統製造業之分化狀況，惟傳統製造業仍持續成長，並努力朝高值化方向，以及跨入AI等供應鏈，進行產業升級轉型，與1960年代之荷蘭產業發展存在顯著差異
tr.en: Taiwan currently faces a divergence in which electronics and ICT manufacturing outperforms traditional manufacturing, but traditional manufacturing continues to grow, is moving towards higher value and into AI and other supply chains, and is upgrading and transforming, markedly different from the industrial development of the Netherlands in the 1960s.

who.en: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

venue.en: post-board-meeting briefing paper “A Study of Taiwan’s Current Industrial Development”

voices.quote: 台灣在先進晶片製造領域的領先優勢為台灣經濟具韌性的關鍵驅動因素，有助維持強勁成長與競爭力；惟「科技業」與「傳產製造業及服務業」間的成長不均，以及人口老化帶來挑戰

tr.zh: 台灣在先進晶片製造領域的領先優勢為台灣經濟具韌性的關鍵驅動因素，有助維持強勁成長與競爭力；惟「科技業」與「傳產製造業及服務業」間的成長不均，以及人口老化帶來挑戰
tr.en: Taiwan’s lead in advanced chip manufacturing is a key driver of its economic resilience and helps sustain strong growth and competitiveness; however, uneven growth between the “technology sector” and “traditional manufacturing and services”, together with population ageing, poses challenges.

venue.en: sovereign rating report on Taiwan (as summarised in a central bank press release)

l.en: Compound annual growth of output, 2017–2024: electronics and ICT manufacturing vs traditional manufacturing (central bank compilation)

q.zh: 產業與股市集中在電子業，是風險，還是分工的結果？
q.en: Is the concentration of industry and the stock market in electronics a risk, or the result of specialisation?

ctx.zh: 2025 年第 4 季，電子產業占上市股價指數的權重是 76.27%，一年前是 71.10%。同一份央行報告裡，風險與優勢寫在同一頁。
ctx.en: In the fourth quarter of 2025 the electronics sector made up 76.27% of the weight of the TWSE index, up from 71.10% a year earlier. The same central bank report sets out the risk and the advantage on the same page.

voices.quote: AI投資熱潮推升臺股AI相關產業股價，惟市場資金集中於少數AI族群，將放大單一產業趨勢變化對整體市場之衝擊。

tr.zh: AI投資熱潮推升臺股AI相關產業股價，惟市場資金集中於少數AI族群，將放大單一產業趨勢變化對整體市場之衝擊。
tr.en: The AI investment boom has lifted the prices of AI-related stocks in Taiwan, but the concentration of market funds in a small group of AI names will magnify the impact on the whole market of any change in a single industry’s trend.

who.en: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

venue.zh: 《金融穩定報告》第 20 期
venue.en: Financial Stability Report, No. 20

voices.quote: 景氣波動風險：若科技景氣反轉，可能加劇台灣經濟波動。

tr.zh: 景氣波動風險：若科技景氣反轉，可能加劇台灣經濟波動。
tr.en: Cyclical risk: if the technology cycle reverses, it may amplify fluctuations in Taiwan’s economy.

who.en: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

venue.zh: 理監事會後記者會參考資料〈當前台灣產業發展之探討〉
venue.en: post-board-meeting briefing paper “A Study of Taiwan’s Current Industrial Development”

voices.quote: 當前台灣經濟表現集中於電子資通訊製造業，並非國內市場失衡，而是順應全球市場需求的專業化分工表現。

tr.zh: 當前台灣經濟表現集中於電子資通訊製造業，並非國內市場失衡，而是順應全球市場需求的專業化分工表現。
tr.en: The current concentration of Taiwan’s economic performance in electronics and ICT manufacturing is not a domestic market imbalance but an expression of specialisation in response to global market demand.

who.en: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

venue.zh: 理監事會後記者會參考資料〈當前台灣產業發展之探討〉

tr.en: The share of stocks trading below their one-year moving average is indeed high, but in essence this still reflects the business cycle and market expectations.

q.zh: 晶圓廠用的水和電，跟民生、農業、減碳怎麼排？
q.en: How should the water and power used by chip fabs be weighed against households, farming and decarbonisation?

ctx.zh: 能源署 2026 年 6 月的報告預估，未來十年用電需求年均成長 2.5%，過去十年是 1.24%。2020 年底，農委會宣布嘉南灌區 1 萬 9 千公頃農田隔年第一期作停灌。
ctx.en: The Energy Administration’s June 2026 report projects electricity demand to grow 2.5% a year over the next decade, against 1.24% over the past one. In late 2020 the Council of Agriculture announced that irrigation would be suspended for the following first crop on 19,000 hectares of farmland in the Chianan district.

voices.quote: 但是目前以10年為目標，我們比較難看到就是，它在過程中，比較務實的一些執行方案，所以我們是期待這個，淨零跟再生能源的部份可以用5年為期。

tr.zh: 但是目前以10年為目標，我們比較難看到就是，它在過程中，比較務實的一些執行方案，所以我們是期待這個，淨零跟再生能源的部份可以用5年為期。
tr.en: With a ten-year target as it stands, what we find hard to see is the more practical implementation plans along the way. So what we hope is that the net-zero and renewable-energy part can be set in five-year terms.

role.en: marketing director, Citizen of the Earth, Taiwan

tr.zh: 台積電能夠宣示加速RE100目標，固然是一個良好的開端，但仍建議台積電學習其他加入RE100的企業公開2040年RE100路徑
tr.en: TSMC’s pledge to bring forward its RE100 target is certainly a good start, but we still advise TSMC to follow other RE100 members and publish its pathway to RE100 in 2040.

tr.en: Electricity use by semiconductors and other high-value-added industries is growing fast and driving economic growth, while use by traditional industries is declining; the two offset each other and overall electricity growth is roughly flat.

q.zh: 科技業的高薪，其他行業的人分到了嗎？
q.en: Have the high wages in tech reached people in other industries?

ctx.zh: 這一題的兩邊都引用同一組薪資統計，讀法不同。科技業工會或勞團對工時與輪班的具名公開說法，我們這次沒有找到。
ctx.en: Both sides cite the same wage statistics and read them differently. We could not find a named public statement from a tech-sector union or labour group on working hours and shifts.

voices.quote: 所得分配惡化：科技紅利集中特定勞動族群，一般民眾感受程度較低，所得分配狀況可能惡化。

tr.zh: 所得分配惡化：科技紅利集中特定勞動族群，一般民眾感受程度較低，所得分配狀況可能惡化。
tr.en: Worsening income distribution: the technology dividend is concentrated among particular groups of workers, the general public feels it less, and income distribution may deteriorate.

who.en: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

venue.zh: 同一份參考資料列出的「須持續注意」風險之一
venue.en: one of the risks “to keep watching” listed in the same briefing paper

voices.quote: 半導體工程師年薪動輒百萬、甚至數百萬新臺幣，分紅與股票獎酬屢創新高；相對之下，餐飲、零售、觀光等內需服務業，薪資成長卻遠落後於通膨。

tr.zh: 半導體工程師年薪動輒百萬、甚至數百萬新臺幣，分紅與股票獎酬屢創新高；相對之下，餐飲、零售、觀光等內需服務業，薪資成長卻遠落後於通膨。
tr.en: Semiconductor engineers routinely earn a million or several million New Taiwan dollars a year, with bonuses and stock awards setting new records; by contrast, in domestic services such as restaurants, retail and tourism, wage growth lags far behind inflation.

role.en: author of “The Economic Chessboard of the New Cold War”

venue.en: book excerpt carried by udn.com

voices.quote: 台積電等科技產業磁吸效應明顯，很多人都跑去科技業，讓傳產在人力市場競爭更加吃力

tr.zh: 台積電等科技產業磁吸效應明顯，很多人都跑去科技業，讓傳產在人力市場競爭更加吃力
tr.en: The pull of TSMC and other tech industries is obvious; many people have gone to tech, making it harder for traditional industries to compete for labour.

tr.zh: 近年台灣傳產製造業薪資漲幅不大，較電子資通訊業漲幅明顯為低，而就業呈現下滑，反映勞動需求減少，與荷蘭病工資上漲之症狀不同
tr.en: In recent years wages in Taiwan’s traditional manufacturing have risen little, clearly less than in electronics and ICT, while employment has declined, reflecting weaker labour demand, unlike the rising wages that are a symptom of Dutch disease.

who.en: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

q.zh: 到海外設廠，是把力量伸出去，還是把「矽盾」分出去？
q.en: Is building fabs abroad an extension of strength, or a sharing-out of the “silicon shield”?

ctx.zh: 台積電在美國亞利桑那的投資規劃，2025 年 3 月加到 1,650 億美元。同年 9 月，美國商務部長公開提出晶片產能台美各半。具名主張赴美設廠是「掏空」的公開原話，我們這次沒有找到。
ctx.en: TSMC raised its planned investment in Arizona to US$165 billion in March 2025. That September the US commerce secretary publicly proposed splitting chip production half-and-half between Taiwan and the United States. We could not find a named, on-the-record statement calling the US investment a “hollowing-out”.

voices.quote: The idea that I pitched [Taiwan] was, let's get to 50-50.

tr.zh: 我向（台灣）提的想法是：我們做到一半一半。
tr.en: The idea that I pitched [Taiwan] was, let's get to 50-50.

venue.zh: NewsNation 訪談（CNBC 報導）
venue.en: NewsNation interview (reported by CNBC)

voices.quote: 台積電在開始談判以前，就已經去美國投資，現在連換來美方、川普的一封信都沒有，只有白宮片面發出的行政命令，讓全體國人非常擔心

tr.zh: 台積電在開始談判以前，就已經去美國投資，現在連換來美方、川普的一封信都沒有，只有白宮片面發出的行政命令，讓全體國人非常擔心
tr.en: TSMC had already invested in the United States before the negotiations began, and now it has not received so much as a letter from the US side or from Trump in return, only an executive order issued unilaterally by the White House, which worries the whole country.

role.en: chairman of the Taiwan People’s Party

venue.en: responding to the US claim that TSMC would invest further in the United States (reported by Storm Media)

voices.quote: 不管是台積電或其他產業，只要他的研發中心、先進製程、最大產量在台灣，台灣就能夠持續穩定的發展

tr.zh: 不管是台積電或其他產業，只要他的研發中心、先進製程、最大產量在台灣，台灣就能夠持續穩定的發展
tr.en: Whether it is TSMC or any other industry, as long as its R&D centre, its most advanced processes and its largest output are in Taiwan, Taiwan can keep developing steadily.

tr.en: So the plans in Taiwan will not only be unaffected, they will be accelerated.

q.zh: AI 行情之外的傳統產業與中小企業，現在過得怎麼樣？
q.en: How are traditional industries and small firms faring outside the AI boom?

ctx.zh: 經濟部的白皮書新聞稿寫，2024 年中小企業超過 171.5 萬家，吸納約 919.4 萬就業人口。同一年，傳統製造業在製造業產值裡的比重降到 53.7%。
ctx.en: According to the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ white-paper release, Taiwan had more than 1.715 million small and medium-sized enterprises in 2024, employing about 9.194 million people. In the same year traditional manufacturing’s share of manufacturing output fell to 53.7%.

voices.quote: 當前傳統製造業則面臨中國大陸低價傾銷及美國關稅政策等嚴峻挑戰，導致出口及產值等表現與電子資通訊製造業出現分歧走勢

tr.zh: 當前傳統製造業則面臨中國大陸低價傾銷及美國關稅政策等嚴峻挑戰，導致出口及產值等表現與電子資通訊製造業出現分歧走勢
tr.en: Traditional manufacturing now faces severe challenges including low-price dumping from mainland China and US tariff policy, so that its exports and output have diverged from those of electronics and ICT manufacturing.

who.en: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

tr.zh: 台灣多數傳統製造業並未出現萎縮或競爭力下滑的疑慮，而持續投入研發經費與增購機器設備，積極朝生產製程優化與產品高值化轉型
tr.en: Most of Taiwan’s traditional manufacturing shows no sign of shrinking or losing competitiveness; it keeps investing in R&D and buying machinery, actively moving towards better production processes and higher-value products.

tr.zh: 預計於未來8年內，由政府加碼投入1,000億元預算撥入「中小微企業轉型升級發展基金」，建立長期、穩定且具制度性的支持體系。
